name: alwatr-devkit-monorepo
description: The Alwatr Developer Kit is a comprehensive ecosystem designed to facilitate your development process. It comprises a diverse range of tools and libraries, empowering you to construct robust applications with enhanced efficiency.
author: S. Ali Mihandoost <ali.mihandoost@gmail.com> (https://ali.mihandoost.com)

scripts.cb: bun run clean && bun run build
scripts.format: bun run format:prettier && bun run format:eslint
scripts.lint: bun run lint:ts && bun run lint:es
scripts.release: git pull && bun run clean && bun run build && bun run lint && bun run test && bun run version
